order_rule: Run order is the 15 sorted by sha256('rtaste seed order 2026-10-02 ' + arXiv id). The first paper is the rehearsal paper and is not part of the results.

replaced.reason: Every main experiment of the paper uses a 397B model, and the paper reports that its method degrades below 27B, so it does not allow informative follow-up experiments on one GPU with models of 8B or smaller. Replaced before any run, by the first spare, which takes the last place.
